integrity: Exact rational-function algebra, explicit positive q-integer factors, and a simple-pole calculation. The standalone code replays finite independent identities; no external scientific audit has been conducted.
scientific_limitations: Complete exact classification is restricted to the shift j=2k; no condition for general j is claimed. An unindexed stronger q-factorial-ratio theorem might imply this result. The proof is symbolic; finite checks are corroborative only.
title: A two-step integrality classification for generalized q-binomial ratios
